1CRN.cif is the public RCSB PDB archive entry 1CRN (crambin), downloaded on
2026-11-16 from https://files.rcsb.org/download/1CRN.cif.
It is retained as an integration fixture for actual PDBx/mmCIF syntax,
Cartesian positions, atom IDs/names, and monoclinic P 1 21 1 symmetry.
The fixture contains 327 asymmetric atom positions, giving 654 positions
when expanded into its crystallographic unit cell. Molecular biological
assembly generation is outside this viewer's scope.
